SELECT messages.rowid as rowid, COALESCE(messages.`id`, ftsResults.`id`) AS `id`,COALESCE(messages.`json`, ftsResults.`json`) AS `json`,COALESCE(messages.`body`, ftsResults.`body`) AS `body`,COALESCE(messages.`conversationId`, ftsResults.`conversationId`) AS `conversationId`,COALESCE(messages.`expirationStartTimestamp`, ftsResults.`expirationStartTimestamp`) AS `expirationStartTimestamp`,COALESCE(messages.`expireTimer`, ftsResults.`expireTimer`) AS `expireTimer`,COALESCE(messages.`hasAttachments`, ftsResults.`hasAttachments`) AS `hasAttachments`,COALESCE(messages.`hasFileAttachments`, ftsResults.`hasFileAttachments`) AS `hasFileAttachments`,COALESCE(messages.`hasVisualMediaAttachments`, ftsResults.`hasVisualMediaAttachments`) AS `hasVisualMediaAttachments`,COALESCE(messages.`hasUnreadPollVotes`, ftsResults.`hasUnreadPollVotes`) AS `hasUnreadPollVotes`,COALESCE(messages.`isChangeCreatedByUs`, ftsResults.`isChangeCreatedByUs`) AS `isChangeCreatedByUs`,COALESCE(messages.`isErased`, ftsResults.`isErased`) AS `isErased`,COALESCE(messages.`isViewOnce`, ftsResults.`isViewOnce`) AS `isViewOnce`,COALESCE(messages.`mentionsMe`, ftsResults.`mentionsMe`) AS `mentionsMe`,COALESCE(messages.`received_at`, ftsResults.`received_at`) AS `received_at`,COALESCE(messages.`received_at_ms`, ftsResults.`received_at_ms`) AS `received_at_ms`,COALESCE(messages.`schemaVersion`, ftsResults.`schemaVersion`) AS `schemaVersion`,COALESCE(messages.`serverGuid`, ftsResults.`serverGuid`) AS `serverGuid`,COALESCE(messages.`sent_at`, ftsResults.`sent_at`) AS `sent_at`,COALESCE(messages.`source`, ftsResults.`source`) AS `source`,COALESCE(messages.`sourceServiceId`, ftsResults.`sourceServiceId`) AS `sourceServiceId`,COALESCE(messages.`sourceDevice`, ftsResults.`sourceDevice`) AS `sourceDevice`,COALESCE(messages.`storyId`, ftsResults.`storyId`) AS `storyId`,COALESCE(messages.`type`, ftsResults.`type`) AS `type`,COALESCE(messages.`readStatus`, ftsResults.`readStatus`) AS `readStatus`,COALESCE(messages.`seenStatus`, ftsResults.`seenStatus`) AS `seenStatus`,COALESCE(messages.`serverTimestamp`, ftsResults.`serverTimestamp`) AS `serverTimestamp`,COALESCE(messages.`timestamp`, ftsResults.`timestamp`) AS `timestamp`,COALESCE(messages.`unidentifiedDeliveryReceived`, ftsResults.`unidentifiedDeliveryReceived`) AS `unidentifiedDeliveryReceived`,
       ftsResults.ftsSnippet, mentionAci, start as mentionStart, length as mentionLength
FROM mentions
INNER JOIN messages ON
  messages.id = mentions.messageId
  AND mentions.mentionAci IN (?1,?2)
  AND 1 IS 1
  AND messages.isViewOnce IS NOT 1
  AND messages.storyId IS NULL
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT messages.rowid, messages.`id`,messages.`json`,messages.`body`,messages.`conversationId`,messages.`expirationStartTimestamp`,messages.`expireTimer`,messages.`hasAttachments`,messages.`hasFileAttachments`,messages.`hasVisualMediaAttachments`,messages.`hasUnreadPollVotes`,messages.`isChangeCreatedByUs`,messages.`isErased`,messages.`isViewOnce`,messages.`mentionsMe`,messages.`received_at`,messages.`received_at_ms`,messages.`schemaVersion`,messages.`serverGuid`,messages.`sent_at`,messages.`source`,messages.`sourceServiceId`,messages.`sourceDevice`,messages.`storyId`,messages.`type`,messages.`readStatus`,messages.`seenStatus`,messages.`serverTimestamp`,messages.`timestamp`,messages.`unidentifiedDeliveryReceived`,
         snippet(messages_fts, -1, ?3, ?4, ?5, 10) AS ftsSnippet
  FROM tmp_filtered_results
  INNER JOIN messages_fts ON messages_fts.rowid = tmp_filtered_results.rowid
  INNER JOIN messages ON messages.rowid = tmp_filtered_results.rowid
  WHERE messages_fts.body MATCH ?6
  ORDER BY messages.received_at DESC, messages.sent_at DESC
  LIMIT ?7
) as ftsResults
USING (rowid)
GROUP BY rowid
ORDER BY received_at DESC, sent_at DESC
LIMIT ?8;

param_style: sql`` positional, dynamic (direction Older, no attachment filter, story replies excluded)
note: The conversation scroll-back page: UNION ALL of the same-received_at tie-break and the strictly-older range, each ordered DESC, outer LIMIT.

  SELECT messages.`id`,messages.`json`,messages.`body`,messages.`conversationId`,messages.`expirationStartTimestamp`,messages.`expireTimer`,messages.`hasAttachments`,messages.`hasFileAttachments`,messages.`hasVisualMediaAttachments`,messages.`hasUnreadPollVotes`,messages.`isChangeCreatedByUs`,messages.`isErased`,messages.`isViewOnce`,messages.`mentionsMe`,messages.`received_at`,messages.`received_at_ms`,messages.`schemaVersion`,messages.`serverGuid`,messages.`sent_at`,messages.`source`,messages.`sourceServiceId`,messages.`sourceDevice`,messages.`storyId`,messages.`type`,messages.`readStatus`,messages.`seenStatus`,messages.`serverTimestamp`,messages.`timestamp`,messages.`unidentifiedDeliveryReceived`

SELECT second.* FROM (
  SELECT messages.`id`,messages.`json`,messages.`body`,messages.`conversationId`,messages.`expirationStartTimestamp`,messages.`expireTimer`,messages.`hasAttachments`,messages.`hasFileAttachments`,messages.`hasVisualMediaAttachments`,messages.`hasUnreadPollVotes`,messages.`isChangeCreatedByUs`,messages.`isErased`,messages.`isViewOnce`,messages.`mentionsMe`,messages.`received_at`,messages.`received_at_ms`,messages.`schemaVersion`,messages.`serverGuid`,messages.`sent_at`,messages.`source`,messages.`sourceServiceId`,messages.`sourceDevice`,messages.`storyId`,messages.`type`,messages.`readStatus`,messages.`seenStatus`,messages.`serverTimestamp`,messages.`timestamp`,messages.`unidentifiedDeliveryReceived`
  FROM messages WHERE
    conversationId = ?7 AND
    (?8 IS NULL OR id IS NOT ?9) AND
    isStory IS 0 AND
    (storyId IS ?10) AND
    ( received_at < ?11 )
    ORDER BY received_at DESC, sent_at DESC

LIMIT ?12;

param_style: $name, dynamic (includeStoryReplies = false adds the storyId predicate)
note: Left-pane timestamp: INDEXED BY a 6-column index over generated columns (shouldAffectActivity, isTimerChangeFromSync, isGroupLeaveEventFromOther), top-1.
sql:
SELECT id, json, body, conversationId, expirationStartTimestamp, expireTimer, hasAttachments, hasFileAttachments, hasVisualMediaAttachments, hasUnreadPollVotes, isChangeCreatedByUs, isErased, isViewOnce, mentionsMe, received_at, received_at_ms, schemaVersion, serverGuid, sent_at, source, sourceServiceId, sourceDevice, storyId, type, readStatus, seenStatus, serverTimestamp, timestamp, unidentifiedDeliveryReceived FROM messages
INDEXED BY messages_activity
WHERE
  conversationId IS $conversationId AND
  shouldAffectActivity IS 1 AND
  isTimerChangeFromSync IS 0 AND
  storyId IS NULL AND
  isGroupLeaveEventFromOther IS 0

param_style: sql`` positional, dynamic (status All, no peer filter so no temp-table join); constants inlined by sqlConstant
note: Calls tab: CTE with three correlated subqueries per call (possibleParent, JSON_GROUP_ARRAY of possibleChildren, GROUP_CONCAT inPeriod), LAG() window to find group parents, GROUP BY CASE, top-N.
sql:
SELECT
  peerId, ringerId, mode, type, direction, status, timestamp, possibleChildren, inPeriod
FROM (
  WITH callAndGroupInfo AS (
    SELECT
      *,
      (
        SELECT callId
        FROM callsHistory
        WHERE
          callsHistory.direction IS c.direction
          AND callsHistory.type IS c.type
          AND callsHistory.peerId IS c.peerId
          AND (callsHistory.timestamp - 14400000) <= c.timestamp
          AND callsHistory.timestamp >= c.timestamp
          AND (
            (callsHistory.status IS c.status AND callsHistory.status IS 'Missed') OR
            (callsHistory.status IS NOT 'Missed' AND c.status IS NOT 'Missed')
          )
          AND callsHistory.status IS c.status
          AND status IS NOT 'Deleted'
        ORDER BY timestamp DESC
      ) as possibleParent,
      (
        SELECT JSON_GROUP_ARRAY(
          JSON_OBJECT(
            'callId', callsHistory.callId,
            'timestamp', callsHistory.timestamp
          )
        )
        FROM callsHistory
        WHERE
          callsHistory.direction IS c.direction
          AND callsHistory.type IS c.type
          AND callsHistory.peerId IS c.peerId
          AND (c.timestamp - 14400000) <= callsHistory.timestamp
          AND c.timestamp >= callsHistory.timestamp
          AND (
            (callsHistory.status IS c.status AND callsHistory.status IS 'Missed') OR
            (callsHistory.status IS NOT 'Missed' AND c.status IS NOT 'Missed')
          )
          AND callsHistory.status IS c.status
          AND status IS NOT 'Deleted'
        ORDER BY callsHistory.timestamp DESC
      ) as possibleChildren,
      (
        SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(callId)
        FROM callsHistory
        WHERE
          (c.timestamp - 14400000) <= callsHistory.timestamp
          AND c.timestamp >= callsHistory.timestamp
          AND status IS NOT 'Deleted'
      ) AS inPeriod
    FROM callsHistory AS c
    WHERE
      status IS NOT 'Deleted'
    ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  )
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG (possibleParent, 1, 0) OVER (
      ) != possibleParent THEN callId
      ELSE possibleParent
    END AS parent
  FROM callAndGroupInfo
) AS parentCallAndGroupInfo
WHERE parent = parentCallAndGroupInfo.callId
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN mode IS 'Adhoc' THEN peerId
    ELSE callId
  END
ORDER BY parentCallAndGroupInfo.timestamp DESC
LIMIT ?1 OFFSET ?2;

FROM (

          AND (callsHistory.timestamp - 14400000) <= c.timestamp
          AND callsHistory.timestamp >= c.timestamp
          AND (

            (callsHistory.status IS NOT 'Missed' AND c.status IS NOT 'Missed')
          )
          AND callsHistory.status IS c.status
          AND direction IS 'Incoming' AND
            status IS 'Missed' AND status IS NOT 'Deleted'
        ORDER BY timestamp DESC
      ) as possibleParent,
      (
        SELECT JSON_GROUP_ARRAY(
          JSON_OBJECT(
            'callId', callsHistory.callId,
            'timestamp', callsHistory.timestamp
          )
        )
        FROM callsHistory
        WHERE
          callsHistory.direction IS c.direction
          AND callsHistory.type IS c.type
          AND callsHistory.peerId IS c.peerId
          AND (c.timestamp - 14400000) <= callsHistory.timestamp
          AND c.timestamp >= callsHistory.timestamp
          AND (
            (callsHistory.status IS c.status AND callsHistory.status IS 'Missed') OR
            (callsHistory.status IS NOT 'Missed' AND c.status IS NOT 'Missed')
          )
          AND callsHistory.status IS c.status
          AND direction IS 'Incoming' AND
            status IS 'Missed' AND status IS NOT 'Deleted'
        ORDER BY callsHistory.timestamp DESC
      ) as possibleChildren,
      (
        SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(callId)
        FROM callsHistory
        WHERE
          (c.timestamp - 14400000) <= callsHistory.timestamp
          AND c.timestamp >= callsHistory.timestamp
          AND direction IS 'Incoming' AND
            status IS 'Missed' AND status IS NOT 'Deleted'
      ) AS inPeriod
    FROM callsHistory AS c

  )
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG (possibleParent, 1, 0) OVER (
      ) != possibleParent THEN callId
      ELSE possibleParent
    END AS parent
  FROM callAndGroupInfo
) AS parentCallAndGroupInfo
WHERE parent = parentCallAndGroupInfo.callId
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN mode IS 'Adhoc' THEN peerId
    ELSE callId
  END
ORDER BY parentCallAndGroupInfo.timestamp DESC;

    membership_event_id,
    event_instance_name,
    event_stream_ordering,
    membership,

FROM
(
    SELECT
        s.room_id,

        s.event_instance_name,
        s.event_stream_ordering,
        s.membership,
        s.sender,
        NULL AS prev_membership
    FROM sliding_sync_membership_snapshots AS s
        INNER JOIN events AS e ON e.event_id = s.membership_event_id
    WHERE
        s.user_id = ?1
        AND e.outlier

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        s.room_id,
        e.event_id AS membership_event_id,
        s.instance_name AS event_instance_name,
        s.stream_id AS event_stream_ordering,
        m.membership,

        LEFT JOIN room_memberships AS m ON m.event_id = s.event_id
        LEFT JOIN room_memberships AS m_prev ON m_prev.event_id = s.prev_event_id
    WHERE
        s.type = ?2
        AND s.state_key = ?3
) AS c
INNER JOIN rooms USING (room_id)
WHERE event_stream_ordering > ?4 AND event_stream_ordering <= ?5
ORDER BY event_stream_ordering ASC;

    UNION ALL
    SELECT er.event_id, er.relation_type, ev.room_id, ev.sender,
        ev.topological_ordering, ev.stream_ordering, ev.type, r.depth + 1
    FROM related_events r
    INNER JOIN event_relations er ON er.relates_to_id = r.event_id
    INNER JOIN events ev ON ev.event_id = er.event_id
    WHERE r.depth <= 3

WHERE (100000 >= stream_ordering)

note: Users page: per-user plays/duration/last-seen aggregated over all history in a derived table (with a correlated latest-row subquery per user), LEFT JOINed back to the last play's history, metadata and media_info rows; COUNT(*) OVER () for the filtered count.

SELECT *, COUNT(*) OVER () AS __filtered_count
FROM (SELECT users.id AS row_id, users.user_id, users.username, (CASE WHEN users.friendly_name IS NULL OR TRIM(users.friendly_name) = '' THEN users.username ELSE users.friendly_name END) AS friendly_name, users.title, users.email, users.thumb AS user_thumb, users.custom_avatar_url AS custom_thumb, COALESCE(history_agg.plays, 0) AS plays, COALESCE(history_agg.duration, 0) AS duration, history_agg.last_seen, history_agg.history_row_id, session_history_metadata.full_title AS last_played, session_history.ip_address, session_history.platform, session_history.player, session_history.rating_key, session_history_metadata.media_type, session_history_metadata.thumb, session_history_metadata.parent_thumb, session_history_metadata.grandparent_thumb, session_history_metadata.parent_title, session_history_metadata.year, session_history_metadata.media_index, session_history_metadata.parent_media_index, session_history_metadata.live, session_history_metadata.added_at, session_history_metadata.originally_available_at, session_history_metadata.guid, session_history_media_info.transcode_decision, users.keep_history AS keep_history, users.allow_guest AS allow_guest, users.is_active AS is_active, users.is_archived AS is_archived, users.deleted_user AS deleted_user
FROM users
LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT reference_id) AS plays, SUM(CASE WHEN stopped > 0 THEN (stopped - started) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN paused_counter IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE paused_counter END) AS duration, MAX(started) AS last_seen, (SELECT s2.id
FROM session_history AS s2
WHERE s2.user_id = session_history.user_id AND s2.section_id NOT IN (SELECT section_id
FROM library_sections
WHERE is_archived = 1)
ORDER BY s2.started DESC, s2.id DESC
LIMIT 1) AS history_row_id
FROM session_history
WHERE session_history.section_id NOT IN (SELECT section_id
FROM library_sections
WHERE is_archived = 1)
GROUP BY user_id) AS history_agg ON history_agg.user_id = users.user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN session_history ON session_history.id = history_agg.history_row_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN session_history_metadata ON session_history_metadata.id = history_agg.history_row_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN session_history_media_info ON session_history_media_info.id = history_agg.history_row_id
WHERE users.deleted_user = ?1 AND users.is_archived = ?2)
ORDER BY friendly_name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT ?3 OFFSET ?4;

modified: the app runs this as INSERT INTO blob_usage (blobId, size, kind) SELECT ...; only the SELECT is kept because data.sql pre-fills blob_usage with the same statement

SELECT blobs.blobId,
       COALESCE(octet_length(blobs.content), 0),
       CASE
           WHEN blobs.blobId IN (SELECT blobId FROM notes WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND blobId IS NOT NULL) THEN 4
           WHEN blobs.blobId IN (
    SELECT attachments.blobId FROM attachments
    JOIN notes ON notes.noteId = attachments.ownerId
    WHERE attachments.isDeleted = 0 AND notes.isDeleted = 0 AND attachments.blobId IS NOT NULL) THEN 3
           WHEN blobs.blobId IN (
    SELECT revisions.blobId FROM revisions
    JOIN notes ON notes.noteId = revisions.noteId
    WHERE notes.isDeleted = 0 AND revisions.blobId IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT attachments.blobId FROM attachments

SELECT noteId,
       SUM(own) AS ownSize,
       SUM(attachment) AS attachmentsSize,
       SUM(revision) AS revisionsSize
FROM (
    SELECT notes.noteId AS noteId, blob_usage.size AS own, 0 AS attachment, 0 AS revision
    FROM notes
    JOIN blob_usage ON blob_usage.blobId = notes.blobId
    WHERE notes.isDeleted = 0

    UNION ALL
    SELECT attachments.ownerId, 0, blob_usage.size, 0
    FROM attachments
    JOIN blob_usage ON blob_usage.blobId = attachments.blobId
    WHERE attachments.isDeleted = 0

    UNION ALL
    SELECT revisions.noteId, 0, 0, blob_usage.size
    FROM revisions
    JOIN blob_usage ON blob_usage.blobId = revisions.blobId

    UNION ALL
    SELECT revisions.noteId, 0, 0, blob_usage.size

    JOIN revisions ON revisions.revisionId = attachments.ownerId
    JOIN blob_usage ON blob_usage.blobId = attachments.blobId
    WHERE attachments.isDeleted = 0

param_style: no params; snapshotsToKeep = 2 and keepNamedSnapshots = true spliced in, kinds inlined
note: "Erase excess revisions" estimate: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY noteId) in a CTE that is referenced four times, IN/NOT IN over UNIONs.
sql:
WITH doomed AS (
        SELECT revisionId, blobId FROM (
            SELECT revisions.revisionId, revisions.blobId,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY revisions.noteId
                       ORDER BY revisions.utcDateCreated DESC, revisions.revisionId DESC
                   ) AS age
            FROM revisions
            JOIN param_list ON param_list.paramId = revisions.noteId
            WHERE revisions.description IS NULL OR revisions.description = ''
        )
        WHERE age > 2)
SELECT SUM(blob_usage.size)
FROM blob_usage
WHERE blob_usage.blobId IN (
    SELECT blobId FROM doomed WHERE blobId IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT attachments.blobId FROM attachments
        JOIN doomed ON doomed.revisionId = attachments.ownerId
        WHERE attachments.isDeleted = 0 AND attachments.blobId IS NOT NULL
)
AND blob_usage.kind NOT IN (4, 3)
AND blob_usage.blobId NOT IN (
    SELECT revisions.blobId FROM revisions
    JOIN notes ON notes.noteId = revisions.noteId
    WHERE notes.isDeleted = 0 AND revisions.blobId IS NOT NULL
    AND revisions.revisionId NOT IN (SELECT revisionId FROM doomed)
    UNION
    SELECT attachments.blobId FROM attachments
    JOIN revisions ON revisions.revisionId = attachments.ownerId
    JOIN notes ON notes.noteId = revisions.noteId
    WHERE attachments.isDeleted = 0 AND notes.isDeleted = 0 AND attachments.blobId IS NOT NULL
    AND revisions.revisionId NOT IN (SELECT revisionId FROM doomed));

sql: SELECT itemID, lastName, firstName, fieldMode FROM items JOIN itemCreators USING (itemID) JOIN creators USING (creatorID) WHERE libraryID=?1 AND itemTypeID NOT IN (3, 27) AND itemID NOT IN (SELECT itemID FROM deletedItems)ORDER BY itemID, orderIndex;

param_style: ? positional
note: Duplicate detection: SUBSTR year of every date field, sorted by value.
sql: SELECT itemID, SUBSTR(value, 1, 4) AS year FROM items JOIN itemData USING (itemID) JOIN itemDataValues USING (valueID) WHERE libraryID=?1 AND fieldID IN (?2,?3,?4,?5) AND SUBSTR(value, 1, 4) != '0000' AND itemID NOT IN (SELECT itemID FROM deletedItems) ORDER BY value;
